usage.outputShape: body.data.items[] array of records; each has .domain, .registrar.name, .registeredAt, .expiresAt, .updatedAt, .statuses[], .nameservers[], .dnssecSigned, .rdapUrl. body.data.total = count. ok flag at body.data.ok.
quirks: Result is nested under body.data (not top-level); records are in body.data.items[]
usage.guide: Call GET https://2s.io/api/domain/whois with a single required query parameter `domain` (e.g. ?domain=example.com), pay $0.001 USDC via x402 on Base. Response is synchronous JSON. Read the registration records from body.data.items[] — each item gives registrar name, registeredAt/expiresAt dates, statuses[], and nameservers[]. body.data.total gives the record count.
